metaDescription: Cal.com is a scheduling platform for booking links, team scheduling, routing and CRM sync, with a free plan for individuals. See its features, Free, Teams, Organizations and Enterprise pricing, strengths and limitations.
overview: Cal.com is a scheduling platform for sharing booking links and running team meetings. The free plan gives one user unlimited links, calendar connections and meetings, with email and SMS notifications, 100+ integrations, payments through Stripe and PayPal and two-way Salesforce and HubSpot sync.

Team plans add round-robin scheduling, collective events, routing forms and workflows, and Organizations adds SAML, SCIM and advanced routing. Cal.com is API-first, with embeds and React components for building scheduling into your own product. The open-source community edition is now published separately as Cal.diy, under the MIT license.

features.title: Booking links
features.text: Unlimited scheduling links and calendar connections on the free plan.

features.title: Team scheduling
features.text: Round-robin, collective and managed events with shared availability on Teams.

features.title: Routing
features.text: Routing forms and attribute-based routing to send bookings to the right person.

features.title: CRM sync
features.text: Two-way Salesforce and HubSpot sync, available on the free plan.

features.title: Cal Video
features.text: Built-in video meetings on every plan, plus Google Meet, Zoom and Teams.

features.title: API and embeds
features.text: Build scheduling into your product with API v2, embeds and React Atoms.

useCases: Routing leads to the right rep
Embedding scheduling in your own app
strengths: A free plan with unlimited links, calendars and meetings.
CRM sync and payments included even on the free plan.
Teams is $12 per user a month, billed yearly.
API-first, with embeds for building scheduling into products.
limitations: The free plan is for one user; teams need a paid plan.
SAML, SCIM and advanced routing need Organizations.
Cal.com itself is no longer open source; the community edition is Cal.diy.
Cal.diy is recommended for personal, non-production use.
Commercial self-hosting of the full product is part of Enterprise.

pricing.summary: Free for individuals. Team plans are priced per user; yearly billing saves 25%. Teams and Organizations have a 14-day free trial.
